explain: Audiophile is a demo store: Stripe test keys, a Neon database from the Vercel integration, a cron secret, a rate-limit key, and (on one Preview branch) the Breakthrough account connection.

env.why: Stripe test-mode secret key (sk_test_). Without it, card payments and hosted Checkout answer 'Stripe test keys are missing'. Live keys are refused: this is a demo store.
env.whyHuman: A credential minted inside Royer's own Stripe account.

steps: In test mode, reveal the Secret key (sk_test_…); never a live key, which the store refuses.
In your own Terminal: vercel env add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY production --sensitive (then preview), and paste it there, not in chat.

env.why: Stripe test-mode publishable key (pk_test_) that loads the card form in the browser. It must pair with the secret key's account; without it the card form cannot load.
env.whyHuman: It comes from Royer's own Stripe account, next to the secret key.

steps: In test mode, copy the Publishable key (pk_test_…).
In your own Terminal: vercel env add STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY production (then preview).

env.why: Signing secret (whsec_) of the test webhook endpoint for https://audiophile.royeradames.com/api/stripe/webhook. Without it the webhook answers 503 and paid orders settle only through the return page.
env.whyHuman: Minted inside Royer's own Stripe account when the endpoint is created or rolled.

steps: Open the endpoint for audiophile.royeradames.com/api/stripe/webhook and reveal its signing secret.
In your own Terminal: vercel env add STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET production --sensitive (then preview).

env.why: Password for the owner queue at /orders. Without it the queue says it is not configured outside localhost.
env.whyHuman: Royer types it to open the queue, so he chooses it.

steps: Choose a password you keep in Bitwarden.
In your own Terminal: vercel env add STAFF_PASSWORD production --sensitive (then preview).

env.why: Vercel Cron sends it as a bearer token to /api/cron/purge-orders, the daily job that deletes orders never paid within 7 days. Without it the purge refuses to run and unpaid orders pile up.
env.agentFix: Generate 32 random bytes in a script and POST them to the Vercel env API as type sensitive for production, without printing; then redeploy.

env.why: Keys the HMAC that stores client addresses and browser sessions for rate limiting, so a copy of the table cannot reveal them. Without it each instance uses its own random key and limits are counted per instance.
env.agentFix: Generate 32 random bytes in a script and POST them to the Vercel env API as type sensitive for production and preview, without printing; then redeploy.

env.why: Audiophile's exact Preview origin registered with the Breakthrough account issuer. Branch-scoped to feat/customer-orders on Preview only, so the doctor (which checks unscoped values) skips it. Without it, accounts show 'coming soon'.
env.agentFix: royer-auth's connect-app.mjs writes the branch-scoped AUTH_* values for the registered branch.

env.why: The issuer origin plus /api/auth (accounts-preview.royeradames.com). Branch-scoped Preview only; production waits for the issuer's production deployment.
env.agentFix: royer-auth's connect-app.mjs writes the branch-scoped AUTH_* values for the registered branch.

env.why: Audiophile's client ID at the issuer. Branch-scoped Preview only.
env.agentFix: royer-auth's connect-app.mjs registers the client and writes it without printing.

env.why: Audiophile's client secret at the issuer, used to exchange sign-in codes. Branch-scoped Preview only.
env.agentFix: royer-auth's connect-app.mjs registers the client and writes it as Sensitive without printing.

env.why: Audiophile's own session-signing secret (32+ characters). Branch-scoped Preview only.
env.agentFix: royer-auth's connect-app.mjs generates it and writes it as Sensitive without printing.

probes.name: production store answers as a demo
probes.ifFails: Check the latest production deployment and its runtime logs.

ignore.reason: Provisioned by the Vercel Neon integration (store audiophile-orders-db for Preview/Development, audiophile-orders-prod-db for Production).
Test-only: the in-memory test database serves one session.
